name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $72,900 on 10 Nov, 16% below its high and 13% lower on the month; no stablecoin de-peg found
state: Bitcoin was near $72,900 on 10 Nov, 15.8% below its 52-week high and 13.2% lower over a month, inside the 25% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). Binance resumed withdrawals on 1 Nov after a $6.3bn breach late in October. This run found no stablecoin de-peg or new exchange halt as of 10 Nov, so Normal is kept while the decline continues.
for_you: Crypto holders face large price swings and have no deposit protection. UK investors in crypto are not covered by the FSCS or the Financial Ombudsman for most losses.
rubric_hit: BTC drawdown 14.9% below the 25% Watch line
why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
